name: Smart Paste
description: AI-powered form filling from unstructured clipboard data.
project_description:
Smart Paste enhances Drupal forms by adding an intelligent "Smart Paste" button that uses AI to analyze unstructured text (emails, messages, documents) and automatically populate relevant form fields. Simply copy text to your clipboard and click Smart Paste to instantly fill out forms with extracted data like names, emails, phone numbers, and addresses.

 Key Features 

 
 AI-powered data extraction from unstructured text 
 Automatic form field population with intelligent field mapping 
 Multiple AI provider support via the AI module 
 Configurable form targeting choose which forms show the button 
 Secure includes CSRF protection and permission controls 
 
 Requirements 

 
 Drupal 11+ 
 AI module 
 At least one AI provider (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.)
